module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input shift_ena,
  input count_ena,
  input data,
  output reg [3:0] q
);

  wire [1:0] s = {clk, shift_ena};

  always @(posedge data) begin
    if (count_ena) begin
      case (s)
        2'b00: q <= 4'b0000; // ADD
        2'b01: q <= 4'b1000; // SUB
        2'b10: q <= 4'b0001; // XOR
        2'b11: q <= 4'b0011; // ORR
        default: q <= 4'b0000;
      endcase
    end
  end

endmodule

  input [31:0] in,
  output [31:0] out
);

  reg [31:0] mem [0:255];  // 256x32 memory array

  assign out = mem[in[9:2]];  // Use bits 9:2 of address to index memory

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input [7:0] in,
  output reg [2:0] pos
);

  always @* begin
    pos = 3'b000; // Default case handles all zeros
    for (integer j = 0; j < 8; j = j + 1) begin
      if (in[j]) begin
        pos = j[2:0]; // Convert position index to binary
      end
    end
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input [3:0] a,
  input [3:0] b,
  input [3:0] c,
  input [3:0] d,
  input [3:0] e,
  output reg [3:0] q
);

  always @(*) begin
    reg [1:0] row, col;

    // Determine active row (one-hot encoding)
    casez (a)
      4'b???1: row = 2'd0;
      4'b??10: row = 2'd1;
      4'b?100: row = 2'd2;
      4'b1000: row = 2'd3;
      default: row = 2'd0; // Assume valid row input
    endcase

    // Determine active column (one-hot encoding)
    casez (b)
      4'b???1: col = 2'd0;
      4'b??10: col = 2'd1;
      4'b?100: col = 2'd2;
      4'b1000: col = 2'd3;
      default: col = 2'd0; // Assume valid col input
    endcase

    // Calculate key value from row and column
    always @(*) begin
      case ({row, col})
        4'b0000: q = 4'd0;  // Key 0
        4'b0001: q = 4'd1;  // Key 1
        4'b0010: q = 4'd2;  // Key 2
        4'b0011: q = 4'd3;  // Key 3
        4'b0100: q = 4'd4;  // Key 4
        4'b0101: q = 4'd5;  // Key 5
        4'b0110: q = 4'd6;  // Key 6
        4'b0111: q = 4'd7;  // Key 7
        4'b1000: q = 4'd8;  // Key 8
        4'b1001: q = 4'd9;  // Key 9
        4'b1010: q = 4'd10; // Key 10
        4'b1011: q = 4'd11; // Key 11
        4'b1100: q = 4'd12; // Key 12
        4'b1101: q = 4'd13; // Key 13
        4'b1110: q = 4'd14; // Key 14
        4'b1111: q = 4'd15; // Key 15
        default: q = 4'd0; // Default to Key 0
      endcase
    end
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input x,
  input y,
  output z
);

  reg [255:0] shift_reg;

  always @(posedge x) begin
    if (y) begin
      shift_reg <= {shift_reg[254:0], 1'b0}; // Shift left, fill LSB with 0
    end else begin
      shift_reg <= {1'b0, shift_reg[255:1]}; // Shift right, fill MSB with 0
    end
  end

  assign z = y ? shift_reg[255] : shift_reg[0];

endmodule
